City of Inglewood

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  May 04, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference
Room at 11:35 a.m.:

  Members Present: Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Ken Campos, City Attorney
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk

  Staff Present:  Toya Ferguson – Finance
  Kenya Crook- City Attorney

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of April 27, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Telecom Law Firm PC - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the
  wireless legal services provided to the City in the amount of $7,312.00.. Motion carried
  unanimously.

  3. Valet Living, LLC – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for the
  services of carpet cleaning for the Main Library in the amount of $4,570.00. Motion
  carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting
  adjourned at 11:45 a.m. Adjournment
